items.headline: Flood Advisory issued May 21 at 9:27PM AKDT until May 23 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by high water due to snowmelt is expected.

* WHERE...Including the following area, Anvik.

* WHEN...Until 100 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 909 PM AKDT, at Anvik, water levels continued to rise
Wednesday with low lying roads and a few structures being
inundated. When the ice jam at Russian Mission fails, water
levels should lower in Anvik as the backwater flows
downriver.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 21 at 9:27PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Yukon Delta

As of Thursday evening, an Ice Jam near Russian Mission continues to
back up water from Russian Mission to Anvik. When the ice jam
eventually releases this water will flow towards the Yukon Delta.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 21 at 1:29PM AKDT until May 22 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low relative humidities during Thursday
afternoon to around 30% combined with gusty winds will bring
elevated fire concerns; however, critical fire conditions are not
expected at this time.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
